title: Capsaicin for the Treatment of Cannabinoid Hyperemesis Syndrome
brief_summary: This study aims to determine if capsaicin cream offers symptomatic relief to patients suffering from Cannabinoid Hyperemesis Syndrome (condition that leads to repeated and severe bouts of vomiting).
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* At least 18 years old
* Diagnosis of cannabinoid hyperemesis syndrome

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients who receive more than 2 anti-emetic therapies prior to screening for enrollment
* Patients who receive haloperidol as an anti-emetic therapy
* Pregnant women
* Prisoners
